title: Shared definitions for the Keysingate core

uri.description: Opaque identifier (Section 4.2). The core neither knows nor checks who issued it.

multihash.description: SHA-256 as a multihash with the 1220 prefix (Section 4).

timestamp.description: Core v2 section 3: UTC with exactly three digits of milliseconds, always. One form per instant, so the verifier compares parsed milliseconds and never a free-form string.

alg.description: Ed25519 is required; ML-DSA-65 is optional. A value outside the enumeration is rejected (Section 4.1), not skipped.

range.description: A contiguous range of serial numbers; both bounds inclusive.

signatures.description: An array of independent signatures, NOT a concatenated string (Section 4.1). An array by construction: a second algorithm is added, it does not replace the first. At most 8 per document (core v2 section 14).

version.description: Core major version. Core v2 reads exactly v=3; earlier documents are verified by core v1, which is kept (architecture v0.3 section 5.3).

context.description: Core v2 section 5: every signed structure names its context. One value per major version.

safe_uint.description: Core v2 section 3: integers only, 0 to 2^53-1, so that JCS gives the same bytes in every language.
